name: @red-cup-engineering/npm-cache-release-recovery-app
description: Audits explicit npm package-lock evidence against a local npm cache and optionally materializes verified release tarballs.

scripts.verify: node --check src/npm-cache-release-recovery-app.mjs && node --check scripts/recover-npm-cache-releases.mjs && node --test test/*.test.mjs && npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts
